fix.q: Rewrite the sentence. Start with *The winner*: They will announce the winner on Friday.
answers: The winner will be announced on Friday.
On Friday the winner will be announced.
The winner will be announced by them on Friday.
fix.why: Who announces it is not important, so *will be* + 3rd form: *The winner will be announced on Friday.*

fix.q: My brother ___ a lot of books when he was off work with a broken leg last winter. (read)
answer_notes: This describes a repeated activity during the time he was off work.
Tas apraksta atkārtotu darbību laikā, kad viņš nestrādāja.
This says it was his habit during that time.
Tas nozīmē, ka tas tobrīd bija viņa ieradums.
This says it was his habit during that time.
Tas nozīmē, ka tas tobrīd bija viņa ieradums.
fix.why: *Read* (past simple) sums up the whole time off work: *My brother read a lot of books when he was off work with a broken leg last winter.* *Was reading* describes a repeated activity during that time; both fit.
fix.why_lv: *Read* (Past Simple) apkopo visu laiku, kad viņš nestrādāja: *My brother read a lot of books when he was off work with a broken leg last winter.* *Was reading* apraksta atkārtotu darbību šajā laikā; der abi varianti.

fix.q:
Ana: 'Did you have lunch with your colleagues yesterday?'
Tom: 'No, when I got to the café, they ___ eating.' (already / finish)
fix.why: Tom got to the café (past simple), and the eating was over before that: *had* + 3rd form: *they had already finished eating*.
fix.why_lv: Toms ieradās kafejnīcā (Past Simple), un ēšana bija beigusies pirms tam: *had* + 3. forma: *they had already finished eating*.
